title: Vibe Coding Has Reached Your Camera
excerpt: People with no software background are using AI tools to add open-gate video, film looks, and missing features to their cameras. The craft now includes understanding the software inside the box.

title: The Background Decides What Your Aperture Does
excerpt: Two frames, same 35mm lens, same f/1.4. One reads as a street photo, the other glows. The difference was never the setting. It was the background, the distance, and the light behind the couple.

title: Compact Cameras Are Up 30 Percent While Full-Frame Falls
excerpt: Interchangeable-lens shipments are down by as much as 20 percent while fixed-lens compacts are up by as much as 30 percent. The brands spent years calling the compact revival a fad. The numbers now say otherwise.
